title: data for times.import
description: Owner imports one task's timing history measured by a predecessor server's clock, once per task (a second import is 409 already_imported). Step records replace the ones task.create started; a step whose state changed since the history was taken gets one transition at the import time. Keys of steps are step ids; the task may no longer be on the board, in which case the history is kept as an archive. For a task on the board it also carries the predecessor's ages, so waiting and idle times do not restart at the migration: last_activity_at becomes the task's last-activity clock (the stalled block; later events move it as usual) and asks[<ask id>].waiting_since becomes the owner-attention age of an ask of this task. Send it after every other import write for the task.
